description: This workspace's plan, what it has sent this billing period, what the period costs so far, and — the fields worth branching on — sending_locked and lock_reason, which name the exact 402 a send would be refused with right now, before a large batch or campaign is tried: on Free a send that would cross the 3,000 included emails is refused whole, and a workspace with no verified payment method cannot send at all, on any plan. lock_reason payment_method_required is the one no tool can fix: only a person can add a payment method, in the dashboard. Pricing is one meter, outbound emails sent: contacts and inbound replies are never counted, and estimated_cents is what the period costs on exactly the curve the invoice uses.
name: get_usage
